title: EnrichItemEvent
description: Per-item NDJSON line emitted by `sqlite-graphrag enrich`, one for each memory or entity the drain touched. Written from `ItemEvent` in src/commands/enrich/events/item.rs and kept equal to it by tests/enrich_status_schema_drift_gate.rs. Every optional member carries `skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none`, so an absent value is an ABSENT KEY and never an explicit null. enrich emits through `emit_json_line`, documented at src/output/stream.rs as the unshaped path, so this envelope never carries the agent-native `agent_surface`, `truncated` or `count` members. `item`, `status`, `index` and `total` are always present.

item.description: Memory name or entity name being processed.

status.description: Processing outcome. 'retyped' (v1.2.8, GAP-SG-279) marks an entity whose type label was rewritten; 'preservation_failed' marks a body-enrich result the preservation gate refused to write.

memory_id.description: Row ID of the memory. Present when the operation targets memories.

entity_id.description: Row ID of the entity. Present when the operation targets entities.

entities.description: Number of entities extracted or updated. Present when status is done or retyped.

rels.description: Number of relationships extracted or updated. Present when status is done or retyped.

chars_before.description: Character count of the original body. Present for body-enrich operation.

chars_after.description: Character count of the enriched body. Present for body-enrich operation.

cost_usd.description: LLM cost in USD for this item. Absent for OAuth subscriptions and dry-run.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds for this item.

error.description: Error message. Present when status is failed.

reason.description: v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-279): why an item was SKIPPED, verbatim from the result that skipped it. The queue recorded this all along; the event did not, so a caller watching the stream could not tell an abstention from a duplicate from a confirmed label without opening the sidecar by hand.

previous_type.description: v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-279): type label the entity carried before a reclassification. Present when status is retyped.

validated_type.description: v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-279): type label written by a reclassification, already shape-normalised. Present when status is retyped.

evidence_chars.description: v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-279): characters of evidence the judgement was made from, so a caller can separate a grounded verdict from a lucky one before trusting the rewrite.

index.description: Zero-based position of this item in the batch.

total.description: Total number of items in the batch.
